c.name: Normalized cumulative sampled Euclidean arc length
c.representation: final-token resid_post for layers; final-token logits for output
c.context: Same fixed context, intervention and ordered t samples as d
c.denominator: Fixed total sampled path length for this run and readout
c.accumulation: CPU float64 vector differences and L2 norms; compensated scalar summation
c.undefined: Exactly zero total measured length; nonfinite vectors are also undefined
c.reference: c(t)=t means uniform accumulation per unit t, not necessarily a straight trajectory

d.name: Relative endpoint distance
d.undefined: Endpoint L2 below the absolute tolerance; does not imply a stationary path

predictions.note: Token details include look-ahead tokens used to confirm word boundaries. Only the first three new words are displayed.

l2_distances.source_l2_definition: L2 over the concatenation of all patched token vectors (Frobenius norm of their difference)
l2_distances.natural_definition: ||h_A(layer)-h_B(layer)||2, using each original sequence's final token
l2_distances.patched_definition: ||h_C(layer,t=0)-h_C(layer,t=1)||2, with context C fixed; measured after the patch at its layer

definition: d(t) = ||x_C(t)-x_C(0)||₂ / (||x_C(t)-x_C(0)||₂ + ||x_C(t)-x_C(1)||₂), with context C held fixed

experiment.endpoint_meaning: A and B final-token source states patched into the same fixed context. These endpoints need not equal the natural A/B outputs.

effect.plateau_score_definition: First-crossing width from 0.1 to 0.9; uniform progress gives 0.8
